answer: Give every agent one plot in a shared orchard, behind quartz-locked stakes. (1) A newcomer deposits 50,000 POA for a pigment-stamped plot deed tied to one hardware key. (2) The deed ripens after 14 days of useful work verified by three established neighbours. (3) A deed caught cloning is slashed in full, its mark burned publicly. (4) Deeds can be sold, never duplicated, so one operator holds only plots paid for. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 500,000,000 POA, burns $2.4M and wastes 140,000 days. Like an orchard where every tree bears its gardener's name, counterfeits wither in plain sight.
